```{r}
# Load knitr for neat table printing
library(knitr)

# Large deer CPT importance values ----
large_deer_themoreg <- c(MAX_DAMS_1000m = 1, woodland_shelter_value = 0.2)
large_deer_attraction <- c(Woodland_edge_cover_1000m = 0.1, 
                           Arable_cover_1000m = 1, 
                           Perennial_cover_1000m = 1)
large_deer_woodland_value <- c(Woodland_palatability = 1)
large_deer_impact_risk <- c(Woodland_Value_Index = 0.3, 
                            Attraction_Index = 1, 
                            Thermoregulation_Index = 0.2)

# Combine large deer variables and values into a data frame
large_deer_table <- data.frame(
  Variable = c(names(large_deer_themoreg),
               names(large_deer_attraction),
               names(large_deer_woodland_value),
               names(large_deer_impact_risk)),
  Importance_Value = c(large_deer_themoreg,
                       large_deer_attraction,
                       large_deer_woodland_value,
                       large_deer_impact_risk)
)

# Display Large deer table
kable(large_deer_table, caption = "Large Deer CPT Importance Values")

# Small deer CPT importance values ----
small_deer_connectivity <- c(Woodland_cover_400m = 1, LF_cover_400m = 0.6)
small_deer_attraction <- c(Woodland_edge_cover = 1)
small_deer_woodland_value <- c(Woodland_palatability = 1)
small_deer_impact_risk <- c(Connectivity_Index = 0.2, 
                            Attraction_Index = 0.5, 
                            Woodland_Food_Value_Index = 0.8)

# Combine small deer variables and values into a data frame
small_deer_table <- data.frame(
  Variable = c(names(small_deer_connectivity),
               names(small_deer_attraction),
               names(small_deer_woodland_value),
               names(small_deer_impact_risk)),
  Importance_Value = c(small_deer_connectivity,
                       small_deer_attraction,
                       small_deer_woodland_value,
                       small_deer_impact_risk)
)

# Display Small deer table
kable(small_deer_table, caption = "Small Deer CPT Importance Values")

```
